Before implementing anything:

1. Read .github/copilot-instructions.md.
2. Read docs/requirements.md.
3. Read docs/architecture.md.
4. Inspect the existing implementation related to this request.
5. Identify affected projects and architectural boundaries.
6. Identify any assumptions or missing requirements.

Do not modify code yet.

Produce:

- Goal
- Current state
- Proposed design
- Files to change
- Tests to add or update
- Risks
- Open questions
